findings.title: wrangler depends on sharp < 0.35.4 (high-severity libheif vulns)
findings.detail: wrangler@4.16.0–4.130.0 → miniflare → sharp < 0.35.4. Advisory GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c covers two libheif heap-buffer-overflow CVEs (GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497, GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545). Current lock resolves to the vulnerable range. wrangler@4.131.0+ carries sharp@0.35.4 and is within the package.json ^4.123.0 constraint.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `npm install wrangler@4.131.1` to update the lock file to the patched release

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18 → 19)
findings.detail: package.json pins react@^18.3.1 and react-dom@^18.3.1; npm latest is 19.3.0. React 19 is a major release with breaking changes (new JSX transform requirements, concurrent features). @types/react and @types/react-dom also need parallel bumps.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `npm install react@^19 react-dom@^19 @types/react@^19 @types/react-dom@^19` and resolve any breaking-change migration items

findings.title: src/shared/urlFilter.ts has no sibling test file
findings.detail: urlFilter.ts was changed in the last 14 days (added as part of filtered-URL routing work) but no src/shared/urlFilter.test.ts exists. The module is exercised indirectly by letterboxdUrl.test.ts, but dedicated unit tests for describeFilter() and buildFilteredUrl() are absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Add src/shared/urlFilter.test.ts covering describeFilter() and the round-trip through withFilter()

findings.title: src/web/App.tsx has no sibling test file
findings.detail: App.tsx changed in the last 14 days. No src/web/App.test.tsx exists. The generation pipeline logic in App is only exercised through end-to-end runs or the visual/generate test suites.
findings.suggested_fix: Add unit tests for the URL-validation and error-display branches in App.tsx

findings.title: src/popup/Popup.tsx has no sibling test file
findings.detail: Popup.tsx changed in the last 14 days. No src/popup/Popup.test.tsx exists. The popup's card-type selection and settings-persistence paths are untested at the unit level.
findings.suggested_fix: Add src/popup/Popup.test.tsx covering card-type gating and settings round-trips
